Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. B is sitting to the immediate left of C. G is not the immediate neighbour of C. H is sitting second to the right of P. Who is sitting on the immediate right of P?
questions.solution:
**Given: **Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) B is sitting to the immediate left of C.

2) H is sitting second to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dff0ed0a27ea26afadfe9356d82da024ddf3728c14e5a70a76449e3191a8f9e.png] 

3) G is not the immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be71436ad7d3cd93eb3a8c961959ddecfcd4ea96749dc4fa8fe8771fc37611a2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement G is sitting on the immediate right of P.

Hence,** "Option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements :**

I. No red is black.

II. No rat is black.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some rat are not red.

II. Some red are black.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d12efad2ccd61249fa399d631ba499afea0ddc1b576eb2059b229d69d1d313a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some rat are not red → Does not follow (As no red is black and no rat is black. As no direct relation is given between red and rat, therefore it is false.)

II. Some red are black → Does not follow (As no red is black. As red cannot be black, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

questions.question:
Which one set of letters when sequentially placed at the gaps in the given letter series shall complete it? 

bc_bcccbcc_ _ _ccccc
questions.solution:
Given series: bc_bcccbcc_ _ _ccccc 

Option 1) cccc → bc__c__bcccbcc__c__ __c__ __c__ccccc → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) ccbc → bc__c__bcccbcc__c__ __b__ __c__ccccc → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) cbcc → bc__c__bcccbcc__b__ __c__ __c__ccccc → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) cccb → bc__**c**__bcccbcc__**c**__ __**c**__ __**b**__ccccc → (It follows the pattern of: bcc - bccc - bcccc - bccccc)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
